dialog.english:
? You're spacing
out.
dialog.translation: Te estás distanciando

dialog.english:
It's nothing. I was thinking about
all the things that happened to us
since we came here.
dialog.translation:
No es nada. Pensaba en todo lo
que nos ha ocurrido desde que
llegamos.

dialog.english:
Yeah, yeah, a lot of things
happened!
dialog.translation:
Si, si, pasaron un montón
de cosas!

dialog.english:
I was just supposed be at camp
with everyone...
dialog.translation:
Se supone que debería estar
en el campamento...

dialog.english:
And then we ran into all these
Digimon, and we're wandering
around in this strange world...
dialog.translation:
Y luego todos estos Digimon, y
vagando en este mundo extraño...

dialog.english: Strange world... how rude, Joe!
dialog.translation: Extraño... Menudo adjetivo Joe!

dialog.english:
I-I'm sorry! But there's also
those black gears that make
peaceful Digimon go berserk...
dialog.translation:
Lo siento! Pero hasta esas ruedas
negras que hacen a los Digimon
volverse locos...

dialog.english: Yeah, those black gears are scary.
dialog.translation: Si, esas ruedas dan mucho miedo.

dialog.english:
But we've pulled through with the
power of evolution!
dialog.translation:
Pero las hemos sacado gracias
a la Digievolución!

dialog.english:
I guess all we can do is try to
find a way back home as soon as
possible.
dialog.translation:
Supongo que todo lo que podemos
haces es buscar un modo de volver
a casa.

dialog.english:
You're worrying too much! Joe,
I'll protect you.
dialog.translation:
Te preocupas mucho Joe! Yo
te protegeré!

dialog.english: Okay...
dialog.translation: Vale...

dialog.english: I-it's cold...
dialog.translation: Qué frio...

dialog.english: I'm wilting...
dialog.translation: Me marchito...

dialog.english: But the cold's not a bad thing.
dialog.translation: No es malo que haga frio.

dialog.english: Ehhh?!
dialog.translation: Ehh?!

dialog.english:
Because if it snows, we can have a
snowball fight and make snow huts!
dialog.translation:
Si nieva, podemos hacer peleas
de bolas de nieve y muñecos!

dialog.english:
I haven't been in a snowball fight
in a long time!
dialog.translation:
No he tirado bolas de nieve en
años!

dialog.english:
What's that?
What's a "snowball fight"?
dialog.translation:
Qué es eso?
Pelea de bolas de nieve?

dialog.english:
It's a game where you fight by
hitting each other with snowballs.
dialog.translation:
Un juego donde combates tirando a
otros pelotas hechas de nieve.

dialog.english: Okay, and what are snow huts?
dialog.translation: Y los muñecos?

dialog.english: I bet it's some kind of food!
dialog.translation: Seguro que son para comer!

dialog.english:
Everyone's taking it easy. But if
the temperature drops lower, it'll 
be even harder to set up camp.
dialog.translation:
Todo el mundo se relaja, pero si
la temperatura baja más va a ser
difícil acampar.

dialog.english:
And it'll be hard to get food. I'm
the one who has to protect
everyone.
dialog.translation:
Y será difícil conseguir comida.
Tengo que protegerles a todos.

dialog.english: Because I'm the oldest...
dialog.translation: Por que soy el mayor...

dialog.english: So what do we do now?
dialog.translation: Qué hacemos ahora?

dialog.english:
Let's keep going! Nothing's gonna
happen if we stay around here
doing nothing.
dialog.translation:
Sigamos adelante! Parados aquí
no pintamos nada.

dialog.english: What? Through these snowfields?
dialog.translation: Qué? Por estos parajes nevados?

dialog.english: We can't keep going like this!
dialog.translation: No podemos seguir así!

dialog.english:
But there's a snowfield in front
of us and a mountain behind us. So
we have to keep going somehow!
dialog.translation:
Hay paraje nevado delante,
montaña detrás. No es que
tengamos muchas opciones!

dialog.english:
Hold on a second. I smell
something strange...
dialog.translation:
Espera un segundo... huele
algo rarao no?

dialog.english: ...Could it be...
dialog.translation: Podría ser...

dialog.english: Ah! Over there!
dialog.translation: Ah! Por allí!

dialog.english: There's smoke that way!
dialog.translation: Hay humo por allí!

dialog.english: That's the smell of hot springs!
dialog.translation: Y huele a aguas termales!

dialog.english: It... it's boiling!
dialog.translation: Y... hierve!

dialog.english:
So that means we can't take a
bath...
dialog.translation: Así no podremos bañarnos...

dialog.english: But it's nice and warm here!
dialog.translation: Pero se está calentito aquí!

dialog.english: At least it's not cold anymore.
dialog.translation: Por lo menos no hace frío.

dialog.english:
How can you be so calm about this?
What are we going to do about
food? Food and...
dialog.translation:
Como podéis estar tan calmados?
Qué haremos con la comida? Comida
y...

dialog.english: There's food, look!
dialog.translation: Hay comida, mira!

dialog.english:
Why is there a refrigerator in a
place like this?!
dialog.translation:
Por qué hay una nevera en un
lugar así?!

dialog.english: Ahhh! We're in luck!
dialog.translation: Ah! Qué suerte!

dialog.english: This is ridiculous! It's absurd...
dialog.translation: Ridículo! Absurdo!

dialog.english: Wanna go play in the snow?
dialog.translation: Quieres jugar en la nieve?

dialog.english:
Wait! I can't leave until I find
out what's in that fridge!
dialog.translation:
Para! No puedo irme hasta saber
que hay en esa nevera!

dialog.english: I wonder what's in there?
dialog.translation: Me pregunto qué habrá?

dialog.english: All right! Let's open it!
dialog.translation: Vale! Vamos a abrirla!

dialog.english: Eggs!

Looks like this'll be today's
dinner!
dialog.translation: Parece que hay huevos para cenar!

dialog.english:
Wait a minute! We can't go around
eating other people's food.
dialog.translation:
Espera un momento! No podemos
comer la comida de otros.

dialog.english:
Wouldn't that just make us
burglars?
dialog.translation: No seríamos ladrones?

dialog.english:
But we don't have much choice.
We're all starving.
dialog.translation:
Pero no tenemos elección...
Nos morimos de hambre.

dialog.english:
If we told the owners about the
situation, they'd understand.
dialog.translation:
Si se lo contásemos a los
propietarios, lo entenderían.

dialog.english: At any rate, it's an emergency.
dialog.translation: Sea como sea, es una emergencia

dialog.english: Let's eaaaat!
dialog.translation: A comer!

dialog.english: Let's eat...
dialog.translation: A comer...

dialog.english:
What's wrong, Joe? Aren't you
going to eat?
dialog.translation: Que pasa Joe? No vas a comer?

dialog.english:
I was thinking about how we
wouldn't have to go through all
this if we were home.
dialog.translation:
Estaba pensando en cómo no
tendríamos que sufrir así si
estuviésemos en casa.

dialog.english:
Hey, everyone! How do you like to
eat your fried eggs?
dialog.translation:
Eh chicos! Cómo os gusta comer
los huevos fritos?

dialog.english:
I eat my eggs with salt and
pepper! Is there any other way to
eat them?
dialog.translation:
Yo los como con sal y pimienta!
Es que existe otra manera?

dialog.english: I put soy sauce on mine!
dialog.translation: Yo echo salsa de soja!

dialog.english: Mayonnaise.
dialog.translation: Mayonesa.

dialog.english: Worcestershire sauce for me!
dialog.translation: Yo salsa Worcestershire!

dialog.english:
I like it with a little citrus
sauce.
dialog.translation: Yo con un poco de salsa cítrica.

dialog.english:
You're all weird! I eat my fried
eggs with sugar! I love putting
fermented soybeans on it, too!
dialog.translation:
Pero qué raros sois! Yo como los
huevos con azúcar! Y con 
soja fermentada, también!

dialog.english: Fermented soybeans?!...
dialog.translation: Soja fermentada?!...

dialog.english:
You all put those strange things
on your eggs...?
dialog.translation:
Pero que clase de porquería
echáis en los huevos?

dialog.english:
You should put salt and pepper on 
your eggs! Not Worcestershire 
sauce or mayonnaise!
dialog.translation:
Los huevos se comen con sal y
pimienta! No mayonesa o
Worcester-lo-qe-sea!

dialog.english:
Joe, you're so stubborn. Always
worrying about little things...
dialog.translation:
Joe, te empeñas mucho. Siempre
con las nimiedades...

dialog.english: What do you mean, I'm stubborn?!
dialog.translation: Como que me empeño?!

dialog.english:
See, look! You get angry so
quickly!
dialog.translation:
Ves? Si hasta te enfadas
fácilmente!

dialog.english: Hey, Joe! Calm down!
dialog.translation: Eh Joe, cálmate!

dialog.english:
Be quiet! I am being calm! I'm
always...
dialog.translation:
Calla! Estoy calmado! Estoy
siempre...

dialog.english:
You're not acting normal today.
Are you tired?
dialog.translation:
Estás muy raro hoy... Estás
cansado?

dialog.english:
I'm not tired! All of you are the
ones who aren't normal here!
dialog.translation:
No estoy cansado! Sois vosotros
los que estáis raros!

dialog.english:
I've got myself together. I...
I've got myself together!
dialog.translation: Me calmo, Me calmo... Me calmo!

dialog.english:
Honestly, I wish Joe would ease up
a bit. He's always like this...
dialog.translation:
Francamente, ojalá Joe se 
relajase un poco. Está siempre
así...

dialog.english: We've got no choice but to go!
dialog.translation: No tenemos otra opción!

dialog.english: No, there's got to be a safer way!
dialog.translation: Tiene que haber un modo seguro!

dialog.english:
What's going on? What are they
fighting about?
dialog.translation: Qué ocurre, por qué se pelean?

dialog.english:
They're fighting over whether or
not we should go up that mountain 
over there, Monte Mugen.
dialog.translation:
Se pelean para decidir si debemos
ir o no allí, el Monte Mugen.

dialog.english:
If we climb it, we'll get a good
view of the area! If we chicken
out, we'll just be stuck here!
dialog.translation:
Si subimos, tendremos una buena
vista de toda la zona! No
hay que ser gallina!

dialog.english:
You're just charging in blindly.
You're going to put everyone in
danger!
dialog.translation:
Vas como pollo sin cabeza. 
Pondrás a todo el mundo en
peligro!

dialog.english:
There are a lot of ferocious
Digimon on that mountain.
dialog.translation:
Hay muchos Digimon feroces
en esa montaña.

dialog.english: Joe! Stop them!
dialog.translation: Joe! Páralos!

dialog.english:
Both of you! We should calm down
and talk this over!
dialog.translation:
Vostros dos! A calmarse
y hablar con calma!

dialog.english: Then what do you think, Joe?
dialog.translation: Ah si? Y tú que opinas Joe?

dialog.english: Who do you agree with?
dialog.translation: Quién tiene la razón?

dialog.english:
(We'll get a good view of the area
if we go up that mountain, but
there are also ferocious Digimon.)
dialog.translation:
(Tendríamos una buena vista de la
zona si subimos, pero tambien hay
feroces Digimon.)

dialog.english: Both of you are right
dialog.translation: Ambos tenéis razón.

dialog.english: Tai is right
dialog.translation: Tai tiene razón

dialog.english: Matt is right
dialog.translation: Estoy con Matt

dialog.english:
Geez, you're unreliable! Anyway,
we should go as far as we can!
dialog.translation:
Pues vaya ayuda! En fin,
deberíamos ir tan lejos como
podamos!

dialog.english: No we shouldn't!
dialog.translation: No, no debemos!

dialog.english: Both of you, listen to me!
dialog.translation: Ambos, escuchadme!

dialog.english: See, look!
dialog.translation: Ves? Mira!

dialog.english:
I'm just trying to think about
everyone's safety!
dialog.translation:
Sólo intento pensar en la
seguridad de todos!

dialog.english: Give it up, Tai.
dialog.translation: Déjalo, Tai.

dialog.english: So what are we going to do now?!
dialog.translation: Entonces qué hacemos ahora?!

dialog.english:
Stop! That's enough, the three of
you!
dialog.translation: Parad! Se acabó, los tres!

dialog.english:
It's getting late, so we'll figure
this out tomorrow!
dialog.translation:
Se hace tarde, lo decidiremos
mañana!

dialog.english: All right, let's go to bed!
dialog.translation: Vale, vayamos a la cama!

dialog.english: Okay. Nobody's awake...
dialog.translation: Vale... duermen...

dialog.english:
If I climb Monte Mugen, I
can figure out what we should do.
dialog.translation:
Si subo al Monte Mugen, podré
decidir qué debemos hacer.

dialog.english:
I... I have to keep myself
together!
dialog.translation: N... no puedo desmoronarme!

dialog.english:
You can do anything as long as you
have fighting spirit, right?
dialog.translation:
Haces lo que te propongas siempre
y cuándo tengas espiritu, no?

dialog.english:
Tai, we're going to end up like
boiled octopus at this rate!
dialog.translation:
Tai, vamos a parecer pulpo cocido
si seguimos así!

dialog.english:
It really is boiling. I'm
disappointed.
dialog.translation: Sí que hierve... que pena.

dialog.english:
But we shouldn't be wasting time
in hot springs now anyway.
dialog.translation:
No deberíamos perder el tiempo
en aguas termales.

dialog.english:
You're right, but I'm still
disappointed.
dialog.translation: Cierto, pero aún así es una pena.

dialog.english: Let's talk about camp.
dialog.translation: Hablemos de acampar.

dialog.english: Let's talk about camp.
dialog.translation: Hablemos de acampar.

dialog.english: Let's talk about camp.
dialog.translation: Hablemos de acampar.

dialog.english: Let's talk about camp.
dialog.translation: Hablemos de acampar.

dialog.english:
Joe, what would you associate with
hot springs?
dialog.translation:
Joe, qué te viene en mente con
el agua termal?

dialog.english: I'd say hot spring boiled eggs!
dialog.translation: Diría que huevos cocidos!

dialog.english: I'd say hot spring steamed buns!
dialog.translation: Diría que bollos al vapor!

dialog.english:
Really...? I don't really like
soft-boiled eggs.
dialog.translation:
Si? No me gustan mucho los
huevos cocidos.

dialog.english: Ah. Really?
dialog.translation: Ah. No?

dialog.english:
I would as well!
I would definitely say the hot
spring souvenir steamed buns.
dialog.translation:
Diría lo mismo!
Los típicos bollos al vapor
que hay de souvenir!

dialog.english:
I wonder if Digimon also bathe in
hot springs...
dialog.translation:
Los Digimon también se bañarán
en termas?

dialog.english:
These really are what you'd call
"hot springs".
dialog.translation:
La verdad, este agua sí está
que arde.

dialog.english: I bet we could make boiled eggs!
dialog.translation: Podríamos cocer huevos!

dialog.english: Maybe a monkey will come to bathe!
dialog.translation: Quizás venga un mono a bañarse!

dialog.english:
Yeah, yeah! I love eating hot
spring boiled eggs with sugar and
fermented soybeans!
dialog.translation:
Si, si! Me encantan los huevos
cocidos con azúcar y
soja fermentada!

dialog.english: Ehh? That, uh, sounds good.
dialog.translation: Eh? Eh... suena bien.

dialog.english:
Eh? I'm kind of scared of monkeys,
I wouldn't want that to happen.
dialog.translation:
Eh? Los monos me asustan, no me
gustaría que ocurriese eso.

dialog.english: Really? But they're so cute...
dialog.translation: Si? Pero si son tan... monos.

dialog.english: I wonder why it's boiling?
dialog.translation: Por qué hervirá?

dialog.english:
Joe, what do you think of when you
hear "hot springs"?
dialog.translation:
Joe, qué te viene a la mente con
las termas?

dialog.english: I'd say the bath clothes!
dialog.translation: La ropa de baño!

dialog.english: I'd say the Japanese-style rooms!
dialog.translation: Los Onsen japoneses!

dialog.english:
I'm bad at wearing bath clothes.
The sash always comes off before I
wake up in the morning.
dialog.translation:
No soy fan de la ropa de baño.
Siempre se me cae cuando me
despierto por la mañana.

dialog.english:
That's because of your sleeping
posture, not the bath clothes.
dialog.translation:
Eso es por cómo duermes, no
culpa de la ropa de baño.

dialog.english:
Yeah! The rooms with floor mats
are so nice! It really makes it
feel like you're at a hot spring!
dialog.translation:
Si! Las salas con sus tapetes en
el suelo están genial. Te hacen
sentir como en las termas!

dialog.english:
I want to be in one of those now,
too...
dialog.translation:
Me gustaría estar en una sala
así, ahora.

dialog.english:
I wonder what's going on at the
bottom of those springs?
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto que hay bajo las
aguas?

dialog.english:
Speaking of hot springs, I wonder
if there's table tennis?
dialog.translation:
Hablando de termas, habrá
ping pong? En Japón es típico.

dialog.english: I've never played table tennis.
dialog.translation: Nunca jugué al ping pong.

dialog.english: I played arcade games.
dialog.translation: Sólo juego en arcades.

dialog.english: Really? It's a lot of fun.
dialog.translation: Si? Si es muy divertido.

dialog.english:
Is that so? Then next time we go
to a hot spring, I'll challenge
you to table tennis!
dialog.translation:
De veras? La siguiente vez que
vayamos a unas termas, te echo
una al ping pong!

dialog.english:
Sure, Any kind of challenge, I'll
take you on!
dialog.translation:
Muy bien, te ganaré a cualquier
reto!

dialog.english:
I don't really play arcade games
whether or not I'm at hot springs.
dialog.translation:
No juego a máquians arcade, 
dentro o fuera de hoteles
termales.

dialog.english:
Hot spring arcade games are
different, though.
dialog.translation:
Las arcade de las termas son
otro rollo...

dialog.english: Hm, I don't know...
dialog.translation: Hm... no sé yo...

dialog.english:
I want to play with you guys
sometime. With the Digimon too,
of course!
dialog.translation:
Me gustaría jugar con vosotros
alguna vez. Y con los Digimon,
claro!
